endorsements.quote: Prospective implementation of the AI solution with proactive outreach to conduct appropriate workup and diagnosis for all highrisk patients will be required to assess the impact on health equity.
Prospective implementation of the AI solution with proactive outreach to provide medical and social support for all high-risk patients can improve health equity.
An AI solution that is evaluated by one setting through HEAAL should be reassessed when a different setting considers implementation.

unlisted_practices: Healthcare organizations should apply the HEAAL health equity assessment every time they consider using an AI solution.
Healthcare organizations should register AI product assessments and report progress on equity assessment procedures in independent registries to provide transparency and traceability.
Healthcare delivery organizations should monitor federal and local regulators, including state Attorneys General and departments of health, to comply with evolving AI policy.
Centralized authorities such as FDA and CMS should coordinate and support local AI governance activities and invest in technical assistance for low-resource settings.
Payers should reimburse AI products that advance equity objectives through rigorous equity assessment at a higher rate than products lacking such evidence.

screen.reason: Presents a governance framework (HEAAL) and procedures for healthcare organizations to evaluate AI equity across the lifecycle based on expert consensus/workshops.
